messages:
sofia (she/her): Quick sync — thinking through console query surface for per-tenant SLO routing + RBAC. Need to decide where to apply tenant isolation checks: API gateway vs query executor. Tradeoffs: cache efficiency, auth surface, SLO routing.
marc: Gateway for coarse auth + tenant id short-circuiting. But SLO routing needs query context to pick fastpath vs slowpath.
elaine: Agree. Gateway does basic auth + tenant ID. Query layer should compute op-cost estimate to pick lane. Affects prefix cache keys.
rahul: If gateway does cost calc we'd duplicate query-shape model. Push cost estimates into query planner inside runtime. Gateway returns tenant id + policy token; runtime decides lanes.
marc: That means runtime needs entitlements. Pass an opaque policy token from gateway to runtime verified locally; avoid full JWT revalidate per-request.
devops-bot: deploy queued: canary/console-query-routing v3 -> infra-staging at 2024-10-03T09:12Z
sofia (she/her): Opaque policy token is good. Need TTL and invalidation semantics. Proposal: token includes policy_version and entitlements hash. Runtime caches for 60s by default, invalidated on policy-change webhook.
elaine: 60s TTL ok, but allow gateway to mark token with `no-cache` for high-sensitivity entitlements. Perf hit acceptable for emergencies.
rahul: Metric tags should include tenant_id, policy_version, route_lane (fast/slow/cached) so console can show per-tenant SLOs and tail latency.
marc: Prefix cache key must include policy_version and tenant_shard to prevent leakage. Example key: `tenant:<id>:policy:<ver>:prefix:<hash>`.
sofia (she/her): Circuit-breaker should be per-tenant-per-lane so noisy tenants don't blow out fast lane.
elaine: Agreed. For rollouts: start with 1% queries on fast lane, monitor p50/p95/p99 and error budget.
rahul: Migration checklist: 1) gateway token + TTL, 2) runtime verify & cache, 3) metric tags, 4) prefix cache key change with fallback, 5) canary rollout script.
marc: Token structure example:
```
{"tenant_id":"t-123","policy_v":"42","flags":["no-cache"],"sig":"<hmac>"}
```
devops-bot: note: loadtest scheduled Fri 17:00 — infra-monitor will flood metrics.
sofia (she/her): @elaine can you own the rollout doc?
elaine: I'll take it. Drafting runbook and will post in #eng-platform by EOD Wednesday. :thumbsup: 
rahul: I'll add dashboards + alerts.
